cyberattack: Other: Suspected web-shell presence / possible website compromise. Installation mechanism and command execution unverified.
data.description:
A URLscan capture dated July 5, 2026, at 06:55:16 UTC shows a WSO YANZ web-shell interface at mas.uagro.mx. The preserved screenshot displays file-management controls and a directory listing under /vhosts/mas/public_html/. The scanner associates the serving network with Universidad Autónoma de Guerrero.

The main HTTP response returned 500 but still rendered the interface. This supports the presence of web-shell-like content, rather than merely a suspicious request. We did not test the controls or independently verify command execution.

Search metadata lists additional captures on July 21, July 29 and August 3 with the same shell-family title. Only the July 5 screenshot was independently inspected. Capture dates do not establish installation dates or uninterrupted persistence.

The original exploitation or installation request was not captured. Authorization, actor identity, data theft and AI involvement are unknown. Full HTML/DOM access required login and was not obtained.

This lead came from a general historical web-shell search, not an OpenAI-linked cluster. Initial local and Slack searches found no matching reference, but novelty to the team remains unconfirmed. No live target was contacted.
data.summary: July 5, 2026: an archived scan of a Universidad Autónoma de Guerrero subdomain shows a web-shell interface and server directory listing. The installation method, attacker, authorization and any AI involvement are unknown.
